content:
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp System time of event creation.
FfcScanId
This value is created and assigned by the Falcon Forensics Collector to groupscanning operations together.
FfcScanType
Describes the type of scan performed by the Falcon Forensics Collector.
Values:
SCAN_UNSPECIFIED (0)
SCAN_FILE (1)
SCAN_MEMORY (2)
SCAN_PROCESS_FILE (3)
SCAN_PROCESS_MODULE (4)
FfcScanResult
Describes the result of the scan performed by the Falcon Forensics Collector.
Values:
INVALID (0)
NOT_MATCHED (1)
MATCHED (2)
FAILED (3)
FfcScanRuleName
A plain text rule name used by the Falcon Forensics Collector.
TargetFileName
The resulting file name that was downloaded
FfcFileIdentifier
24-byte concatenation of a filesystem volume's UUID and a file's inode value.
TargetProcessId
The unique ID of a target process (in decimal, non-hex format). This field exists in almost all events, and it represents the ID of the process
that is responsible for the activity of the event in focus. For example, the TargetProcessId of a process that performed thread injection in
an InjectedThread event
ImageFileName
The full path to an executable (PE) file. The context of this field provides more information as to its meaning. For ProcessRollup2 events,
this is the full path to the main executable for the created process.
MD5HashData
The MD5 hash of a file
SHA1HashData
The SHA1 hash of a file.  In most cases, the hash of the file referred to by the ImageFileName field.
SHA256HashData
The SHA256 hash of a file. In most cases, the hash of the file referred to by the ImageFileName field.
Values:
STATIC_SHA256_DOPPELGANGING (0x56f3097c4d5bf4c7cffef168ee732e1c78f2ee62bc1c1ba61c219226bef619f8)
STATIC_SHA256_SYSTEM (0x03312a19baa7ab137c09127c6feb58c05216a7880d3c9e6ae54a8bcda460f92a)
